title: Cartwise+ Membership Early-Notice Extension for Pauses
content:
Early notice adds a notice extension to the Cartwise+ Membership pause allowance.

**Rule.** A request made at least 28 calendar days before the next renewal date adds 7 days; one made at least 14 and fewer than 28 days before adds 3 days; any later request adds 0 days.

| Calendar days from the request date to the next renewal date | Days added |
|---|---|
| 28 or more | 7 |
| 14 to 27 | 3 |
| 13 or fewer | 0 |

**Counting.** The days before the next renewal date are the calendar days from the request date up to the day before the renewal date, both included — the same as the renewal date less the request date. The renewal date is the end of the current period on the membership record.

## Hypothetical boundary cases (next renewal date 30 September)

| Request date | Days before | Days added |
|---|---|---|
| 2 September | 28 | 7 |
| 3 September | 27 | 3 |
| 16 September | 14 | 3 |
| 17 September | 13 | 0 |
